messages:
Alex: Quick sync — planning v2.14.1 rollout across US/EU/APAC. Proposed UTC windows below. Need cutoff times for changelog + branch freeze. Also canary capacity check. TL;DR: want to avoid peak office hours in each region.

Priya: thanks Alex. dropping the windows here, + a couple Qs: can we do staggered starts (US -> EU -> APAC) or do we need overlap for health checks?

Alex: staggered start preferred. short overlap (~15m) between handoffs for smoke tests. planned order: US -> EU -> APAC.

Jamie: SGTM. putting a soft branch freeze 2h before each region's window. i.e. feature merges cut 2h before region start; emergency fixes still go to hotfix branch.

Victor: note on changelog: the release team needs final changelog by cutoff. Is that 2h before first region or 2h before each region?

Sasha: prefer 2h before the region-specific window so EU changelog can include last-minute EU-only config flips.

Alex: agreed. so schedule: changelog cutoff 2h before each region. we'll tag release branches per region: release/v2.14.1-us, release/v2.14.1-eu, release/v2.14.1-apac.

Priya: Can we lock main merges to only CI-passing PRs + 1 approval during the windows? I can add a temporary branch protection rule.

Jamie: please do. also reminder to bump the SDK client minor version in the same PR that updates server behaviour — reduces downstream surprises.

Alex: here's the proposed windows (UTC) for July deploy:
```
US:   2026-07-15 02:00 - 04:00 UTC  (evening PT / ET-friendly)
EU:   2026-07-15 08:30 - 10:30 UTC  (morning CET)
APAC: 2026-07-15 20:00 - 22:00 UTC  (SGT / AEST)
```

Victor: small nit: EU start at 08:30 to avoid the CET daily jobs at 08:00. ok for me.

Sasha: Canaries — plan: 5% traffic US first for 20m, then 25% for 20m, then full. EU/APAC similar but with regional capacity checks. Any objections?

Jamie: no objections. add a rollback gate step after each canary stage. include a clear health check list: 200/latency/error budget thresholds.

Priya: changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/432 — please add any customer-impacting notes. I left placeholder for quantization fix.

Alex: CI status?

Victor: CI green on main + e2e flaky tests retriggered. I disabled the slow test suite for the release pipeline to speed things up.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job: canary/us-west v2.14.1 -> 5 pods, 20m. Triggers: smoke-tests, latency-checker, autotest-runner.

Sasha: capacity check: Dedicated pool has 3 spare nodes in us-west, can autoscale + burst to 6. EU has 2 spare nodes, APAC 1 spare node. Recommend scaling EU pool to +1 before APAC rollout.

Jamie: Ops action: @oncall please prepare rollback playbook and make it visible in the release runbook. Link it under the release PR.

Alex: I'll add runbook snippets to the release PR. Also reminder: update the console feature flag default to 'on' after EU canary passes (manual flip).

Priya: tagging owners for final checks: @Sasha (infra), @Victor (CI), @Jamie (release ops). please ack by EOD.

Victor: ack.

Sasha: ack, infra will scale EU pool one hour before EU window.

Jamie: ack, will post rollback playbook and set branch protection.

Alex: perfect. final checklist for tomorrow: 1) bump SDK in server PR 2) finalize changelog entries 3) branch protections 4) canary jobs scheduled 5) infra scale plan. If all good, I'll schedule the deploy windows and rotate the oncall for the launch. :rocket:

Priya: one more: @integrations-team — notify key customers about potential brief degradation during rollout? I'll draft a short blurb.

Alex: thanks. if anything pops up ping this thread.

Sasha: quick note — if APAC spike happens we fall back to quantized model variant to save memory. test that path in staging today.

Victor: committing a staging test now. will post results.

Jamie: last: changelog freeze reminder will be automated via a bot message 2h before each region window.

Alex: thanks everyone.
